result:
Implementation complete. Summary of changes:

- **`src/types/member.ts`**: added `MemberAbsence`.
- **`src/schemas/member.ts`**: added `setAbsenceSchema` / `SetAbsenceInput`.
- **`src/server/db/schema/members.ts`** + **`migrate.ts`**: added the `member_absences` table (one row per org+user, upserted on replace) to both the Drizzle schema and the fallback SQL fresh-migration path.
- **`src/server/repositories/_mappers.ts`** + **`member-repository.ts`**: `toAbsence` mapper, plus `findAbsence`, `findActiveAbsence`, `upsertAbsence`, `deleteAbsence`, `clearDelegateReferences`.
- **`src/lib/absence.ts`** (new): pure `[startsAt, endsAt)` window checks (`isAbsenceActive`, `hasAbsenceEnded`).
- **`src/server/services/member-service.ts`**: `setAbsence`, `clearAbsence`, `getAbsence` with the specified validation/permission rules, plus cascading cleanup of the absence and any delegate references in `removeMember`.
- **`src/server/services/issue-service.ts`**: assignment redirection in both `createIssue` and `assignIssue` (self-take exception, no chaining) — the delegate becomes the stored assignee, so events/audit/permissions follow automatically.
- **`src/server/services/notification-service.ts`**: overdue alerts redirect to the delegate (sweep itself untouched); comment mentions alert both the mentioned user and their active delegate, deduped via the existing `notify()` `Set`.

Verified with a temporary test file (removed afterward) covering validation, permissions, tenant scoping, redirect/no-chain/self-take behavior, overdue redirection, mention fan-out, and member-removal cascades — all passed, and the full existing suite (617 tests) plus `tsc --noEmit` remain green.
